TEST-GAP / HARDENING REMEDIATION COMPLETE — all seven discovered_from tickets merged to main and CLOSED via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 each):
- A a01d (change 1814): fetcher per-project fan-out resilience — the proven root cause of the outage (one bad mapped key no longer aborts the whole pass).
- B fea4 (1813): bridge-state writes adopt shared write_lock + commit+push + atomic_write seams (removes the ad-hoc hand-commits behind the LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO leak).
- C 7332 (1815): scope active/done by statusCategory.
- D a011 (1816): reconcile preflight verifies every mapped project + legacy_default is visible before any live mutation.
- E 6454 (1821, merged commit 95f97cbeb6): alert_store adopts fsutil.atomic_write seam. NOTE: the sibling binding-snapshot seam conversion was ATTEMPTED and REVERTED — routing _commit_binding_store_snapshot through commit_and_push_tickets_branch (git add -A) broke reconcile idempotency (test_reconcile_idempotency.py::test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head: redundant commit on an unchanged pass). CI caught it; scope was narrowed to the behavior-preserving alert_store change only.
- F 209b (1819 + follow-up 1823): syntactic write-time project-key validation reusing _validate_project_key; follow-up maps the new ValueError to a clean RebarError(returncode=2) at the _lib_ops seam for CLI+MCP consumers.
- G 9702 (1820): opt-in, read-only 'bridge fsck --live-visibility' diagnostic reusing D's check_mapped_project_visibility via the probe= seam (core doctor stays Jira-free).

REMAINING on THIS bug = the three LIVE operational-verification ACs (restore live origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json to canonical; a live 'rebar bridge preview' against REB runs without the JQL parse error; next scheduled Reconcile Bridge run green via gh run view). These require production/live-Jira access and the next scheduled run — left for the operator to perform/verify; not auto-actioned. Follow-up gate 638a (shrink-only ratchet forbidding tracker git mutations outside the _store seam) is now unblocked and ready.
